title: FoundKeep — launch tracker
goal: Take FoundKeep from friends beta to a public launch: strangers can find it in the Chrome Web Store, App Store and Google Play, sign up safely, pay $5/month on web or iOS, and we find out about failures before they do.

phases.name: Clean house
phases.goal: One branch, one plan, one place to track it.
phases.exit: main is the only branch; every ask and backlog item is triaged into this tracker.

phases.name: Safety net
phases.goal: We can recover any data and hear about failures before users do.
phases.exit: Nightly verified off-site backup with a tested restore, server errors logged and alerted, uptime alerts, CI on every push.

phases.name: Open signups safely
phases.goal: Strangers can sign up without breaking the service or each other.
phases.exit: Limits sized for 1,000 users and the hardening items in the private audit closed.

phases.name: Accounts, email & legal
phases.goal: Accounts are verifiable and recoverable, and the legal pages match the product.
phases.exit: Verified email, reset by email, privacy/terms/refund pages that satisfy Paddle, Apple and Google.

phases.name: Monetization
phases.goal: A stranger can pay $5 on web or iOS and get Pro; friends keep what they have.
phases.exit: A live purchase verified on web and iOS, and the global beta-Pro flag turned off.

phases.name: Product gaps
phases.goal: Close the asks that make the first week feel finished.
phases.exit: Every ★ item marked for launch is live in prod and in the shipped apps.

phases.name: Store launch
phases.goal: FoundKeep is installable from all three stores.
phases.exit: Chrome Web Store on the current build, App Store approved, Google Play in production.

phases.name: Launch
phases.goal: People hear about it and we learn from them.
phases.exit: Launch posts out and the first 100 non-friend signups.
